profile.summary: Software engineer with experience in both financial services and defense industries. Interest in low level systems, performance, resource management, and optimization.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Conversational Commerce

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Jet Black
positions.description:
Jet Black (a Walmart company) is a members-only, text-based personal shopping and concierge service that combines the convenience of e-commerce with the customized attention of a personal assistant. With the ultimate goal of creating the next step change in retail through conversational commerce, Jet Black promises members the fastest, most delightful end-to-end shopping experience possible. As the first stand-alone company incubated by Walmart's Store No. 8, Jet Black is on a mission to give time back and make life more enjoyable.

Primary work in Java, JavaScript/Node.JS, GraphQL/Typescript, SQL. 
Technologies: Kafka, Elastic, Kibana, Splunk
Developing a search engine to help agents to search through the JetBlack catalog to offer to customers.

positions.title: Associate Application Developer
positions.locationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
positions.description:
JPMorgan Chase & Co. (NYSE: JPM) is a leading global financial services firm with assets of
$2.4 trillion and operations worldwide. The firm is a leader in investment banking,
financial services for consumers and small businesses, commercial banking, financial
transaction processing, and asset management. A component of the Dow Jones Industrial
Average, JPMorgan Chase & Co. serves millions of consumers in the United States and
many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under
its J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Information about JPMorgan Chase & Co. is available at
www.jpmorganchase.com

Primary work on distribution systems on JPMC Compute Backbone HPC platform in C++, Java, Python, Bash

Developed various services (REST API, cron jobs, loaders, monitors, alert systems, LDAP authentication, middleware services). 

Worked with IBM Symphony Platform

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Telephonics is an advanced-technology leader in highly sophisticated surveillance, communications, analysis and integration solutions. These systems are deployed across a wide range of land, sea and air applications, providing aerospace, defense and commercial customers with a distinct tactical advantage.

Responsible for the systematic approach to the development of requirements, design, implementation, test, and maintenance of software components. 

Primary work in communication systems and RADAR systems in C and C++

positions.title: Operating Systems Course Assistant
positions.description:
CS350 -Operating Systems

Help students to understand concepts in operating systems, multithreading, multiprogramming, and resource management, and improve their programming skills.

positions.title: Physics Laboratory Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Perform demonstrations about physics concepts to students and assist during student lab work

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
AN/ZPY-4 RDR-1700B+ Radar System 

Radar designed and developed for the Northrop Grumman MQ-8 Fire Scout UAV

Recorded radar data are subjected to "playback", rerunning flight data through the system.
Developed a standalone graphical user interface playback application to operate on both Linux and Windows. The playback application is to be used to support flight data analysis.
